title: Code and data for: Bridge-power procurement for AI data centres: the value of an imperfect grid-connection date estimate
description: Model, run definitions, analysis code, derived results and the job-level run archives (runs.zip, runs_es.zip) behind the paper 'Bridge-power procurement for AI data centres: the value of an imperfect grid-connection date estimate'. A multistage stochastic mixed-integer program plans on-site bridge power (gas combined cooling, heat and power, diesel and rented gensets, a battery and purchased standby) for a 150 MW AI campus before its grid-connection quarter is known. The analysis values a utility's connection-date estimate by exact evaluation under specified forecast-error laws and compares it with knowing the connection date from the start. Code: MIT licence. Data and results: CC BY 4.0.
